title: No musicians in the family
summary: His mother sang in the choir; a great uncle in Boston was said to be a professor of music, but he never met him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you have any musicians in your family?
Not as I know of it. My mother used to sing, I'd say, very well in the choir, you know, until she began to have trouble. Then she just continued it. But otherwise, I don't know of any in the family.
You didn't know any great uncles or anything like that?

I knew my uncle and my mother was a brother, but we had a great uncle. He moved years before that and lived in Boston, Massachusetts. But we lost track of it. I lost track of a lot of my folks. I have people here, but I don't know where they are now. I'm trying to locate some of them now before I leave.
The one who lived in Boston, did he go to music school or play in Michigan?
Well, he was supposed to be a professor. Yeah. So she told me. I never did see him or meet him.
Didn't know his name or anything?
No. She told me, but I'd forgotten.
